### Background
Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq) are among the most commonly used next-generation sequencing techniques. WGS reveals the entire genomic makeup of an organism, while RNA-Seq profiles transcriptomic levels at a given condition. Distinguishing studies based on the strategy used can inform researchers who need specific data types.
